color-no-hex.message: Hardcoded hex colors are only allowed in web/src/styles/tokens/primitives.css — add a --color-* primitive there and reference it with var() instead. See docs/design-system.md.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-*) N%, transparent) against a primitive instead of rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() literals — keeps every color traceable to tokens/primitives.css.

overrides.comment: primitives.css is the only file allowed to originate a raw color value.
login.css pins its own pre-auth dark ramp (--lg-*) independent of the authenticated theme — documented exception, mirrors tokens/primitives.css's dark register verbatim.
preferences.css theme swatches must show both light and dark simultaneously, so they can't resolve a single var() — documented exception.
artifact.css's frame-preview background is a literal white document page in every theme — documented single-use exception (see inline comment).
